analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI entering oversold territory, ADX trend weak. Volume ratio at 0.73, indicating contraction. Weekly ADX at 27.6 confirms a clear trend, but daily MACD histogram continues to worsen. 4-hour RSI at 32.9 entering oversold. Overall, maintaining a wait-and-see approach until confirmation of buying pressure.
